segments.text: Queſt. 45th. What doth the Reſurrection of Chriſt profit us?

Anſ. Firſt; by His Reſurrection He hath overcome Death, that He might make us Partakers of that Righteouſneſs which He had purchaſed for us by His Death. Secondly, we are alſo by His Power, raiſed up to a new Life. And laſtly, the Reſurrection of Chriſt is a ſure Pledge of our bleſſed Reſurrection.
